author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Two drivers were seriously injured when a motorcycle and an SUV collided on Route 18 in Lakeville, police said.

The crash was reported at about 6:24 p.m. Monday and involved a Yamaha motorcycle and a Honda CR-V. Police said the man riding the motorcycle and the woman driving the SUV were both taken to Morton Hospital with serious injuries. Neither vehicle was carrying a passenger.

Route 18 was closed while emergency crews treated the drivers and investigators documented the scene. The closure was part of the immediate response; officials did not say the road remained closed after the investigation at the scene was completed.

Authorities have not released the names or ages of the drivers, an update on their conditions, or a preliminary cause. The investigation is continuing, and police have not announced citations or charges. Drivers with relevant dash-camera footage or firsthand information can contact Lakeville police. Until investigators release additional findings, it is not clear how the vehicles came into contact.
dek: A Yamaha motorcycle and Honda CR-V collided on Route 18 Monday evening, sending both drivers to Morton Hospital.
headline: Motorcycle-SUV crash seriously injures two in Lakeville
